reason:
Harvested all four wordings by driving master.html (approach: owner-flight, phone, desk, day, print; record: desk, print) and reading render-b.js:298-408 plus b.css:493-497. The strings are real, but the finding's frame and its fix are both wrong.

(1) 'Four ways' is inflated. Nothing shows four. The row chip is F.stateLabel.cancelled ('Not going ahead') - the product's global MILESTONE_STATE_LABELS token (fixture.js:70-76), a status label, not a sentence; holding a status chip and a prose sentence to one register is not a copy defect. The two folded variants ('One thing is not going ahead.' / 'The city hotel shortlist is not going ahead.') are the deliberate owner/guest audience split documented at render-b.js:292-297, and no reader ever sees both - they are alternatives, not duplication. Measured co-occurrence is two forms, never more: closed, the chip is outside the section box (owner-flight closed: secBottom 1958, chip top 2021 - laid out but unpainted inside the collapsed details), so folded readers see only their own sentence.

(2) The twelve-pixel adjacency the finding leads with is a defect that was already found and is guarded by a PASSING gate. interaction-check.mjs:1637-1653 - 'The past is stated once. Round 3 opened the rows and left the sentence beside them, printing a title the reader could already see twelve pixels above it' - asserts, for record/desk, record/print and approach/print, exactly one visible .b-behindNote AND that it repeats no visible title. That is precisely why the line reads 'One of them did not happen.' and not the hotel's name. The finding restates the handled half and calls the remedy the defect.

(3) The fix would make the artifact worse and breaks that gate. Where rows are visible, listed ? null : folded means the folded sentence is not rendered at all - verified on record/desk and record/print, where 'One of them did not happen.' is the ONLY visible prose in the whole block. Deleting the dropped node leaves zero notes there, failing notes.length === 1 at all three gate call sites, and strips the record room and the printed keepsake of any sentence about the past, ending both on a bare cancelled row. The finding's own escape hatch - 'keep only the folded summary' - does not exist on those surfaces. It also hands back exactly the regression render-b.js:391-394 records as fixed: the sheet ending on a cancelled hotel search. On the day, closed (the default a guest meets), the block already closes on 'Venue walk-through, 19 September.' The failure case requires the reader to press open the record themselves.

(4) The residue is one tense choice: 'did not happen' (past) under a heading that reads 'Behind you'. Past tense inside an explicitly past-tense frame is defensible, not defective, and the row chip it sits under is a status token that cannot follow it without changing MILESTONE_STATE_LABELS product-wide. Taste with no argument that survives the gate. Not a restatement of round 6's count-partition fix (render-b.js:397-400, gate at interaction-check.mjs:1966-1979) - different axis - but nothing here clears a 9.5 bar.
sharpenedFix: If the panel wants the tense harmonised anyway, the only safe edit is one word-class inside the existing node - 'One of them did not happen.' -> 'One of them is not going ahead.' (and the plural branch to match). That keeps exactly one visible note, keeps all three 'past is stated once' gate cases green, keeps the block closing on a sentence rather than a cancelled row, and touches no status token. Deleting the node, as proposed, must not be done.
